maddeler.e:
أشتبك (form VIII)
# أَشْتَبِكُ (ʔaštabiku) /ʔaʃ.ta.bi.ku/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِشْتَبَكَ (ištabaka)
# أَشْتَبِكَ (ʔaštabika) /ʔaʃ.ta.bi.ka/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَبَكَ (ištabaka)
# أَشْتَبِكْ (ʔaštabik) /ʔaʃ.ta.bik/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِشْتَبَكَ (ištabaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
